name: Darwin Gödel Machine
description: Self-improving coding-agent framework. Its evolving artifact is an agent code bundle, evaluated on coding episodes, rather than a universal single-file task solution.
limitations: A local native CLI driver and JSON result reader are implemented for the pinned SWE-bench and Polyglot interfaces.
Native runs use an isolated checkout and the framework's own coding-episode evaluation. Cached initial scores remain identified as upstream baselines.
An Arena task-library agent-bundle/episode evaluator is not yet implemented. Native benchmark support does not imply compatibility with all Arena tasks.
The native environment and a full model-driven run have not been verified. Docker resources need framework-specific cleanup.
